name: Funes (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Funes (a castle on red within an ornate yellow cartouche).
history: Municipal flag of Funes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Funes arms — castle on red within an ornate cartouche
cartouche, castle and crown of the arms
